evidence: judge-context/checks.json: patch_applies is true; no commands were recorded and no tests were run per the experiment setup.

Generated tree differs from base only in CHANGELOG.md, rich/default_styles.py, rich/palette.py, rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py, and new tests/test_palette.py (diff -rq against base snapshot).
Staged diff of generated tree (git diff --cached) matches patch.diff exactly, ignoring index lines.
Expected test_columns string added by the patch is byte-identical to the reference's expected string (3171 bytes each).

Traced test_time_elapsed_column by reading: -:--:-- before start; 0:00:05 at t=5; frozen 0:00:10 after finish; 0:00:02 after reset. Traced test_palette via STANDARD_PALETTE.__rich__() returning Table with 16 rows (table.py:255-257 row_count = len(rows)).
generated/rich/palette.py:20 Palette.__rich__ is placed in the Palette class, matching the reference location.
generated/rich/progress.py:325 TimeElapsedColumn sits beside BarColumn/TimeRemainingColumn, matching the reference.
generated/rich/progress.py:449 finished_time field is on Task, matching the reference.
generated/rich/default_styles.py:117 progress.elapsed style is in DEFAULT_STYLES, matching the reference.
generated/rich/progress.py:325 class TimeElapsedColumn(ProgressColumn) with render(task) -> Text, the same public name and signature as the reference.
generated/rich/palette.py:20 __rich__(self) -> "Table" takes no arguments and returns a Table, matching the reference.

generated/rich/progress.py:449 finished_time: Optional[float] = None is a dataclass field with a default; add_task passes visible/fields/_get_time by keyword (base rich/progress.py ~966-972), so positional construction is unaffected.
generated/rich/progress.py:492-494 finished returns finished_time is not None, matching the reference contract.
generated/rich/palette.py:7-8 TYPE_CHECKING-only import of Table adds no runtime dependency.

generated/rich/palette.py:23-26 function-local imports of color, style, table, and text avoid a cycle: base rich/color.py:8 imports ._palettes at module level, and base rich/_palettes.py:1 imports .palette, so a module-level import in palette.py would be circular. The patch's comment at line 22 states this accurately.
Relative import style (palette.py:3, .color_triplet) matches the existing file convention.
generated/rich/default_styles.py:117 registers "progress.elapsed" style, which generated/rich/progress.py:332 and :334 use for TimeElapsedColumn output.
TimeElapsedColumn subclasses ProgressColumn (generated/rich/progress.py:325), the same registration pattern as TimeRemainingColumn.
Palette exposes __rich__ (generated/rich/palette.py:20), the rich renderable protocol method, so it is picked up without other registration. The reference does the same.
No new third-party or project dependencies. The patch uses only existing rich modules (table, text, style, color) plus stdlib timedelta, which progress.py already imports (base rich/progress.py:6).
pyproject and requirements files are unchanged (diff -rq lists no such files).
Elapsed-state tracking is in Progress.update (generated/rich/progress.py:832-833) and Progress.advance (generated/rich/progress.py:893-894), where completion already occurs, matching the reference.
Rendering stays in the column (generated/rich/progress.py:325-334) and in Palette (generated/rich/palette.py:20-46), matching the reference.
Clearing on reset goes through Task._reset (generated/rich/progress.py:536), which both update's total-change path (806) and Progress.reset (858) already call.
TimeElapsedColumn uses the existing ProgressColumn.render extension point (generated/rich/progress.py:325-334), with no parallel render path.
Palette rendering uses the existing __rich__ protocol method (generated/rich/palette.py:20) and the existing Table.add_column/add_row API (generated/rich/palette.py:34-44).
generated/rich/palette.py:20-46 adds rendering to the Palette data class, as the reference does. The Table/Text/Style/Color dependencies are used only through their public constructors.
generated/rich/progress.py:330 reads task state through the Task properties (finished, elapsed, finished_time) rather than recomputing them.
No transport, persistence, or framework boundary is crossed.

generated/CHANGELOG.md:8-12 adds an [Unreleased] / Added entry, consistent with the Keep a Changelog header at CHANGELOG.md:1-7. The reference instead uses a 9.6.0 heading; this is an optional choice, not a convention violation.
Docstring style ("""...""" with ``None`` and Optional[...] type prefixes) matches the surrounding progress.py attribute docstrings (base rich/progress.py:443-447).
tests/test_palette.py:5-8 and tests/test_progress.py:83 follow the existing test_*/-> None style of the repo.

TimeElapsedColumn shows -:--:-- before start (generated/rich/progress.py:331-332), a live elapsed value while running (:330), and a frozen value once finished (:330 with finished_time set at :832-833 / :893-894).
Reset clears completion state (generated/rich/progress.py:536, reached via :806 and :858), so a reset task shows live elapsed again.

Palette.__rich__ renders index, RGB, and color swatch columns, with RGB text formatted as (r, g, b). Base palette entries are tuples (base rich/_palettes.py:21-23), so this matches the reference's repr(color) output.
Shared with the reference and not a patch defect: Task.finished now depends only on finished_time, so a task created already complete or with directly assigned completed is not reported finished.
